summary: Android viewport height is 844px vs React's 288px, causing Android to show large empty space below the message row.
Timestamp formatting differs: React shows '07/13 05:57 AM' in monospace; Android shows 'Kee... 07/13 05:57' with an additional truncated 'Kee…' label between author and date.
Avatar presence: React shows a square pixel-art avatar with an orange status dot at bottom-right; Android avatar appears without the orange status dot.

Inline mention pills render differently: Android's '@artin' appears as plain bold underlined text rather than a filled yellow rounded pill, and '#607' / '#对话流专修' lose their pink rounded-pill backgrounds, appearing as boxed text or bare hashtags.
Line wrapping/break behavior differs — Android breaks '我已 claim) —slice-1 那个' across more lines with different whitespace and breaks after Chinese punctuation more aggressively than React.
likelyCauses: Android component uses a manual-rect crop (260×844) instead of element-bounds, inflating the visible canvas and adding empty space below the message.
Avatar status-indicator overlay missing in Android implementation.
Mention/reference token styling (pill background, border-radius, fill color) not ported to Android markup styles.
Date locale formatter outputs a short weekday prefix ('Kee…') before the date on Android, likely due to a different locale/format string.
Text wrapping uses a wider measure or different break rules on Android (possibly due to font metrics differing from web monospace fallback).
suggestedFixes: Crop Android snapshot to element bounds (260×288) so vertical sizing matches React for fair comparison.
Re-add orange online-status dot to the avatar in Android MessageRow.
Restore pill background (yellow for @mention, pink for #reference) with correct corner radius in Android Compose styling.
Normalize timestamp formatter to output 'MM/dd hh:mm a' format without leading weekday abbreviation, matching React.
Tune Android text wrapping (line-breaks, breakStrategy, or max width) to match React's wrapping; ensure CJK punctuation does not force orphan breaks.
intentional: Difference in overall canvas height (288 vs 844) is likely a test crop artifact, not an intentional design change.
